parameters.query: INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_design', 'running') RETURNING id

SELECT p.id, p.name as project_name, p.project_type, p.budget_target, p.budget_flexible, p.location_city, p.location_province, p.property_type, p.property_area_m2, p.urgency, c.name as client_name, c.email as client_email FROM projects p JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id WHERE p.id = $1::uuid

SELECT id, version, summary, pii_decrypt(client_needs_enc)::jsonb AS client_needs, objectives, constraints, style_preferences, rooms_affected FROM briefings WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND status = 'approved' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT content, model_recommended, temperature FROM agent_prompts WHERE agent_name = 'agent_design' AND prompt_type = 'system' AND is_active = true LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO design_options (project_id, execution_id, exec_status, option_number, title, description, intervention_logic, rooms_layout, technical_notes, conflict_points, pros, cons, estimated_complexity) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, 'draft', $3::int, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb, $8::jsonb, $9::jsonb, $10::jsonb, $11::jsonb, $12) RETURNING id, option_number, title

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.project_id, $('Start Execution').first().json.id, $json.option_number, $json.title, $json.description, $json.intervention_logic, JSON.stringify($json.rooms_layout), JSON.stringify($json.technical_notes), JSON.stringify($json.conflict_points), JSON.stringify($json.pros), JSON.stringify($json.cons), $json.estimated_complexity] }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO approvals (project_id, approval_type, requested_by, summary, details, related_entity, expires_at) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'design_review', 'agent_design', $2, $3::jsonb, 'design_options', NOW() + INTERVAL '72 hours') RETURNING id, webhook_token

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.project_id, 'Seleccion de opcion de distribucion para ' + $json.project_name, JSON.stringify({project_name: $json.project_name, option_count: $json.option_count})] }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO activity_log (project_id, agent_name, action, phase_at_time, output_summary, status, details) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_design', 'options_sent_for_selection', 'briefing_done', $2, 'success', $3::jsonb)

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Build Selection Email').first().json.project_id, $('Build Selection Email').first().json.option_count + ' opciones de distribucion enviadas al arquitecto', JSON.stringify({option_count: $('Build Selection Email').first().json.option_count, awaiting: 'architect_selection'})] }}

parameters.query: UPDATE design_options SET is_selected = true, selected_at = NOW() WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND option_number = $2::int
UPDATE approvals SET status = 'approved', decided_by = 'architect', decided_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1::uuid
UPDATE agent_executions SET status = 'completed', finished_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid; UPDATE design_options SET exec_status = 'confirmed' WHERE execution_id = $1::uuid

INSERT INTO project_intelligence (project_id, agent_name, key, value) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_design', 'design_intelligence', $2::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (project_id, agent_name, key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = now()

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Receive Project').first().json.project_id, JSON.stringify({ options_generated: $('Collect All Options').first().json.options_count || 0, selected_option: $('Process Selection').first().json.selected_option || null, selected_option_title: $('Mark Option Selected').first().json.title || '' })] }}
